description: Дрогобицька міська рада: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Дрогобицька міська рада. Coverage: Дрогобицька міська рада. The listing groups 9 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Перелік автомобільних послуг м.Дрогобич; Детальний список вулиць Дрогобича; Перелік перевізників, що надають послуги пасажирського автомобільного ; Схема організації дорожнього руху. Formats seen: XLSX, PNG, JPEG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
